text: WHEN THE EARTH quakes with her [last] mighty quaking,
and [when] the earth yields up her burdens,<sup foot_note=99001>1</sup>

foot_notes.99001: I.e., all that was hitherto hidden in it, including the bodies—or the remnants—of the dead.

text: and man cries out, "What has happened to her?"—
on that Day will she recount all her tidings,
as thy Sustainer will have inspired her to do!<sup foot_note=99002>2</sup>

foot_notes.99002: I.e., on the Day of Judgment the earth will bear witness, as it were, to all that has ever been done by man: an explanation given by the Prophet, according to a Tradition on the authority of Abu Hurayrah (quoted by Ibn Hanbal and Tirmidhi).

text: On that Day will all men come forward, cut off from one another,<sup foot_note=99003>3</sup> to be shown their [past] deeds.

foot_notes.99003: Lit., "as separate entities" (ashtatan). Cf. 6:94—"And now, indeed, you have come unto Us in a lonely state, even as We created you in the first instance": thus stressing the individual, untransferable responsibility of every human being.

text: And so, he who shall have done an atom's weight of good, shall behold it;
and he who shall have done an atom's weight of evil, shall behold it.
